correctness.rationale: For any projective plane of order q>=2, its incidence bipartite graph G has 2N vertices, (q+1)N edges, diameter 3, and cycle rank (q-1)N+1=q^3. At scale 2 same-part distances 2 and only incident mixed edges. Partition the clique complex into U and V, where U is simplex on all points with cones over each line point-set and V is the symmetric lines construction. Each has dominated-vertex collapses to a simplex; U intersect V is exactly G. Homotopy pushout of two contractible pieces along G yields suspension Sigma G, wedge q^3 S². Scale1 is G, scale3 full simplex; hence claimed q^3 bars in each of dimensions1 and2. Verified independent combinatorial small cases q2,q3: edges21,52, beta1 8,27; face vectors start (14,63,112,84,42,14,2) and (26,208,728,1534,2600,3432,3432). General theorem is axiomatic not finite extrapolation.
